title: 第 56 章 今后不要再招惹陈默了第 55 章 这个混账居然敢打我
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 半个时辰之后陈默已经离开了大长老的府邸，在回去路上的时候脸上倒是没有什么表情。
而大长老站在门口看着陈默，等他走远了之后才转过身来随后目光就落在陆云和陆瑶身上。
“还傻愣在那里干什么，陆云你还不赶紧给我进来。”
听到大长老这番话以后陆云就低着头跟在大长老身后，随后跟着他一块走进了屋内。
而陆瑶站在原地还想说什么，可看到大长老的脸色之后选择了沉默。
只见大长老在椅子上坐下来之后看着陆云，只见他的眼神很冷就连语气也带着几分怒意。
“你回去之后好好管教管教你妹妹，今天这件事情做的太过分了。”大长老说道。
“以后再让她去找陈默的麻烦，老夫连你一块罚。”
“师父弟子知道了，我回去之后一定好好管教她。”
“知道就好老夫今天把话放在这里，以后谁都不许再去招惹陈默。”
“你们要是再敢去找他的麻烦就别怪老夫不念师徒情分了。”
而陆云咬着牙点了点头然后转身退出了房间，他走出去之后看到陆瑶还站在院子里脸色铁青。
“走吧。”陆云说道。
“回去再说。”
随后陆瑶跟在他身后两人一起离开了大长老的府邸，一路上陆瑶的脸色都很难看。
两人走远之后周围的弟子们开始议论起来，虽然他们的声音很小但还是能听到几句。
“看到了吗大长老刚才那个态度，对陈默客客气气的反而对自己徒弟一顿责罚。”
“那当然了陈默现在是什么人，沈长老最看重的弟子连大长老都要给他三分面子。”
“陆瑶还想去招惹陈默这不是自讨苦吃啊。”
“你看她刚才刚被陈默打了一巴掌还被大长老训斥了一顿，估计现在气疯了吧。”
那些议论声断断续续的传进陆瑶的耳朵里，因此她的脸色也是越来越难看。
“你们给我滚。”陆瑶突然转过身冲着那些弟子怒吼道。
“谁再敢多嘴一句我撕烂他的嘴。”
那些弟子被她吓了一跳连忙散开了，可他们走远之后还在小声嘀咕着。
只见陆瑶站在原地气得浑身发抖，她的呼吸急促胸口剧烈的起伏着。
今天她先是被陈默扇了一巴掌然后又被大长老当着那么多人的面训斥，现在连那些普通弟子都在看她的笑话。
从小到大她从来没有受过这么大的屈辱，而这一切都是拜陈默所赐。
“我一定要杀了他，要不是那个混蛋我也不会遭受这般奇耻大辱。”
而陆云站在她旁边听了这话之后眉头皱了起来，他上前一步拉住了陆瑶的胳膊。
“你别冲动师父说了不让我们再招惹陈默，你要是再去找他的麻烦师父不会放过你的。”
“我不甘心，哥难道你甘心吗我们两个修为都跌了那么多而且全都是拜他所赐。”
“大长老不帮我们报仇就算了还跑去给他赔罪，我们凭什么要继续这样忍气吞声。”
“忍一时风平浪静，师父既然这么做肯定有他的道理，我们还是听师父的吧。”
content_en:
Half an hour later, Chen Mo had left the great elder's mansion, and there was no expression on his face when he was on his way back.
The First Elder stood at the door and looked at Chen Mo. After he walked away, he turned around and then his eyes fell on Lu Yun and Lu Yao.
"Why are you still standing there stupidly? Lu Yun, why don't you come in quickly?"
After hearing what the great elder said, Lu Yun lowered his head and followed behind the great elder, and then followed him into the house.
Lu Yao stood there and wanted to say something, but after seeing the great elder's face, she chose to remain silent.
The great elder sat down on the chair and looked at Lu Yun. His eyes were cold and his tone was a bit angry.
"You should discipline your sister well when you go back. What you did today went too far." The elder said.
"If you let her cause trouble for Chen Mo in the future, I will punish you as well."
"Master's disciple knows, I will discipline her well after I return."
"As long as you know, I will put my words here today. No one is allowed to provoke Chen Mo again in the future."
"If you dare to find trouble with him again, don't blame me for not caring about the relationship between master and disciple."
Lu Yun gritted his teeth and nodded, then turned and exited the room. After he walked out, he saw Lu Yao still standing in the yard with a livid face.
"Let's go." Lu Yun said.
"Let's talk about it when we get back."
Then Lu Yao followed him and the two of them left the great elder's mansion together. Lu Yao's face looked ugly along the way.
After the two walked away, the surrounding disciples began to talk. Although their voices were very low, a few words could still be heard.
"Did you see the great elder's attitude just now? He was polite to Chen Mo but punished his apprentice."
"Of course, who is Chen Mo now? Elder Shen's most valued disciple, even the Great Elder, has to give him three points of respect."
"Lu Yao still wants to provoke Chen Mo, so she's not asking for trouble."
"Look, she was slapped by Chen Mo just now and scolded by the great elder. She is probably going crazy now."
Those comments reached Lu Yao's ears intermittently, so her face became increasingly ugly.
"Get out of here." Lu Yao suddenly turned around and roared at the disciples.
"Whoever dares to say another word will have his mouth torn to pieces."
The disciples were startled by her and quickly dispersed, but they were still muttering quietly after they walked away.
Lu Yao was seen standing there, trembling with anger, her breathing rapid and her chest rising and falling violently.
Today, she was first slapped by Chen Mo and then scolded by the great elder in front of so many people. Now even the ordinary disciples are watching her jokes.
She has never suffered such humiliation since she was a child, and all of this was thanks to Chen Mo.
"I must kill him. If it weren't for that bastard, I wouldn't have suffered such shame and humiliation."
Lu Yun stood next to her and frowned after hearing this. He stepped forward and took Lu Yao's arm.
"Don't be impulsive. Master told us not to provoke Chen Mo again. If you go to trouble him again, Master won't let you go."
"I'm not willing to accept it, brother, are you willing to accept it? Our two cultivation levels have dropped so much, and it's all thanks to him."
"If the Great Elder doesn't help us avenge him, he just goes to apologize to him. Why should we continue to swallow our anger like this?"
"Be patient for a while. Since Master must have his reasons for doing this, we should listen to Master."
